comment.body:
Saved [3e012974](https://github.com/c933103/AN-Paint/commit/3e01297441a58214c5dc705fc9a41ceff51f0311) on `review/assembly-position-catalogues-20261015`, directly based on PR head 1ec079c. Its complete 1,124-blob tree/modes, parent/ref and four changed files were read back exactly. The PR branch stays at 1ec079c while run 530 finishes API 35, avoiding cancellation of that already-running diagnostic. Its JVM step has passed; lint/API 35 remain pending.

This adds the six fully reviewed traditional Mongolian values, bringing the source branch to 294 values / 49 scoped catalogues, with ten still unresolved. Original draft SHA256 caeaa3bc01377181e47b369f36ec5f5f20d37052a70da08f6eb1c69de327800e was retained. Independent full-value review found one crop-noun spelling correction: `ᠣᠭᠲᠣᠯᠣᠯᠲᠠ` → `ᠣᠭᠲᠤᠯᠤᠯᠲᠠ`, confirmed in the [official dictionary](https://mongoltoli.mn/dictionary/detail/66635). Original Help SHA256 7d4dae12d1928384d82a482fb1da46cc295afd49c0cb21de36ff7f89000ab7e5; corrected complete Help 1527a65c2ac9e2dfc808e4386c7825cba0756ec46de92a10cf5de55959625bf1 was independently reread and accepted. Physical axes, integer/zero/ceiling, unchanged other images/crops/sizes, overlap, later-import stacking and expansion all remain. Idiom confidence is moderate; no native-speaker or whole-language certification.

The suffix-encoding review also exposed an implementation defect: Kotlin's `isBlank()` consumes U+202F, so vertical wrapping replaced a Mongolian nonbreaking suffix boundary with ASCII space. That changes spacing and suffix glyph selection, not just line breaks. [Unicode section 13.5](https://www.unicode.org/versions/Unicode17.0.0/core-spec/chapter-13/) distinguishes legacy NNBSP suffix boundaries from ordinary spaces. A local HarfBuzz 10.2.0 probe with the exact bundled font (SHA256 805a55e10492c547ccadc1ad04faabdef61a74a5c02ecce69748378d66ef032d) confirmed differing glyph sequences for ASCII substitution. This probe is not Android raster evidence.

The bounded fix keeps nonbreaking glue atomic across sideways/CJK/emoji neighbors and preserves it during trimming; draw orientation is unchanged. Four new native regressions cover complete six-value preservation, tiny/wide wraps, CJK/emoji and ordinary/horizontal controls, exact native ink versus the ASCII-substitution negative control, and full caption spans with ellipsis disabled. An atomic word may exceed the requested wrap height; no full-viewport usability claim is made. Local all-resource AAPT2 and 82 focused assembly host checks pass; full host runs and exact-source hosted native tests are pending. No completeness assertions or raster tolerances were weakened.
